assertion: An event exists, described as "Magnitude 7.3 earthquake".
judge_quote: A powerful magnitude 7.3 earthquake struck off the coast of southern Mexico on Friday
evidence_cited: A powerful magnitude 7.3 earthquake struck off the coast of southern Mexico on Friday, triggering a tsunami warning for parts of the Pacific.

The quake, which struck near the fishing town of Puerto Madero in Mexico at 08:49 local time (14:49 GMT) on Friday, had a depth of 15.2 km (9 miles), according to the United States Geological Survey (USGS).

assertion: An event exists, described as "Tsunami warning issued".
judge_quote: triggering a tsunami warning for parts of the Pacific
evidence_cited: A powerful magnitude 7.3 earthquake struck off the coast of southern Mexico on Friday, triggering a tsunami warning for parts of the Pacific.
The US Tsunami Warning System had warned of possible " hazardous tsunami waves" along the nearby coasts of Mexico and Guatemala.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Tsunami waves recorded".
judge_quote: It later recorded waves of 0.3m (1.1 feet) above tide level in Puerto Madero and Chiapas in Mexico
evidence_cited: It later recorded waves of 0.3m (1.1 feet) above tide level in Puerto Madero and Chiapas in Mexico.
In this case, the waves lasted for 12 minutes in Puerto Madero and 28 minutes in Chiapas.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Tsunami threat passed".
judge_quote: Several hours after the initial warning was issued, the centre said the threat had passed but advised people in affected areas to "remain observant and exercise normal caution near the sea"
evidence_cited: Several hours after the initial warning was issued, the centre said the threat had passed but advised people in affected areas to "remain observant and exercise normal caution near the sea".

assertion: An event exists, described as "Series of aftershocks".
judge_quote: A series of aftershocks, with magnitudes between 4.7 and 6, have been recorded
evidence_cited: A series of aftershocks, with magnitudes between 4.7 and 6, have been recorded.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Magnitude 5.6 earthquake".

assertion: An event exists, described as "Evacuations in Guatemala and El Salvador".
judge_quote: In Guatemala and El Salvador, the tremor shook buildings, triggering evacuations and causing some people to run from their homes, Reuters news agency reported
evidence_cited: In Guatemala and El Salvador, the tremor shook buildings, triggering evacuations and causing some people to run from their homes, Reuters news agency reported.

judge_quote: the country's emergency management agency had been deployed

assertion: A claim exists, described as "No serious impact".
judge_quote: Mexico's navy secretary Admiral Raymundo Morales told a press conference that there was "no serious impact"
evidence_cited: Mexico's navy secretary Admiral Raymundo Morales told a press conference that there was "no serious impact", but that people were being advised to stay away from beaches.

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Moderate intensity felt".
judge_quote: Governor Salomón Jara Cruz, of the southern Mexican state Oaxaca, said the quake was felt with "moderate intensity"
evidence_cited: Governor Salomón Jara Cruz, of the southern Mexican state Oaxaca, said the quake was felt with "moderate intensity" but no significant damage had been reported.

assertion: A claim exists, described as "No serious impact in Chiapas".
judge_quote: Eduardo Ramírez, governor of the state of Chiapas ... also said there had been no serious impact
evidence_cited: Eduardo Ramírez, governor of the state of Chiapas closest to the epicentre, also said there had been no serious impact, but added he had instructed his cabinet to suspend administrative activities and urged the private sector to do the same.
